{{Quote|I do it mostly for the creative challenge, don't you know?|Magar Jaros|<ref name="GG11" />}}
'''Magar Jaros''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] counterfeiter operating in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. He was wanted for [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgery]] and criminal conspiracy, although he maintained he performed the forgery because of the "creative challenge." He used [[Spectacles|computerized magnifocals]] to correct his defective vision.

Although considered a B-list counterfeiter, Jaros was particularly skilled with the [[tri-laser engraver]], and his talents were widely respected. However, he refused to "produce" more than a few thousand credits each time. He commonly spoke in [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]] and was known to leave any planet after a few months.

He was considered mild-mannered, insipid and lacking in social skills, even refusing to work with subordinates. Due to his lack of self-confidence, some believed that Jaros had been rejected and humiliated in the past, and that he performed his crimes as some sort of personal revenge.
